subject.title: feat(googlechat): support Application Default Credentials for outbound auth

question: Should Google Chat `serviceAccountAdc` be allowed to use `google-auth-library`'s Compute ADC metadata-server path directly, or must this PR add an OpenClaw-owned guard around those metadata requests before merge?
rationale: The remaining blocker is a security-boundary policy choice: the implementation is useful and opt-in, but the dependency-owned metadata lookup bypasses the guarded transporter OpenClaw currently injects for Google auth requests.

options.title: Require a guarded metadata path
options.body: Ask the PR to route or constrain Compute ADC metadata-server requests through an OpenClaw-owned guard while keeping `serviceAccountAdc` opt-in.

options.title: Accept opt-in dependency metadata ADC
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly approve `gcp-metadata` direct metadata-server calls as the intended behavior for this Google Chat config key.

options.title: Pause keyless Google Chat ADC
options.body: If the metadata-server boundary is not acceptable now, pause or close this direction until a sponsored auth design is ready.

recommendation.title: Require a guarded metadata path
recommendation.body: Ask the PR to route or constrain Compute ADC metadata-server requests through an OpenClaw-owned guard while keeping `serviceAccountAdc` opt-in.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent Koc authored and merged the prior Google Chat auth transport hardening that defines the current guarded auth boundary.
